content.text:
Build passes. Here's what was implemented:

**Migration** — [20260324160000_add_booking_embed_url.sql](supabase/migrations/20260324160000_add_booking_embed_url.sql) adds `booking_embed_url` column to `platform_config`.

**Admin panel** — [ConfigTab.tsx](src/components/admin/ConfigTab.tsx) now has a "Booking Embed URL" input field where you can paste your Tidycal link. Saving stores it in the database (empty = null).

**Book Demo page** — [BookDemo.tsx](src/pages/BookDemo.tsx) reads the URL from `platform_config` via `usePlatformConfig()` and renders it as an iframe. Shows a loader while fetching and a placeholder if no URL is set.

**How to use:**
1. Run `supabase db push` to apply the migration
2. Go to Admin > Platform Settings > Configuration
3. Paste your Tidycal embed URL (e.g. `https://tidycal.com/your-link`)
4. Save — the Book Demo page will immediately show the embed
